memory_update.text: The strongest underfollowed restaurant supply-chain candidate in this node is CHEF because it sits directly on specialty restaurant menu inputs while remaining less obvious than restaurant operators or broadline distributors.
WEST is a useful hidden beneficiary because coffee/tea beverage programs can be a restaurant dependency even when the company is classified as coffee or ingredients rather than restaurant supply.
FARM is a speculative exception: the equity is tiny, but the restaurant and foodservice dependency is explicit enough to keep it in the discovery lane.

Next expansion pass should test adjacent chokepoints such as broadline distributors, cheese/dairy, bakery/dough, packaging, cold-chain logistics, and kitchen equipment vendors with restaurant concentration.

node: Vertically integrated food manufacturing and distribution
summary: This pass expands the restaurant supply-chain node beyond obvious restaurant operators into vertically integrated distribution and hidden B2B beverage/ingredient suppliers. The clearest anchor is Domino's internal dough-and-food distribution network.
